answer: A newcomer earns standing by keeping one vault at a meadow's edge for a season. Each checkout enters an open log, stamped with the umber tag of the plot it serves and countersigned by the borrower on return. Two unrelated neighbours audit the vault against the log within ten days. A missing item, a copied entry, or a second claim on the same checkout voids the season, forfeits the deposit, and bars the sponsor for a season. One honest keeper tends one vault; a thousand fake identities would need a thousand stocked, logged, and audited vaults.
